title: مفردات حسب الـ topic وترقيات آمنة (safe upgrades)
blocks: كلمات حسب الـ topic · ترقيات آمنة · تمارين (مع الإجابات)

مواضيع Task 2 تأتي من عدد قليل من مجالات المجتمع المحددة. إذا عرفت 20–25 كلمة لكل مجال، فستأتيك الأفكار واللغة بسرعة في أي سؤال. القائمة أدناه فيها فقط كلمات يمكن استخدامها بأمان في essay بمستوى Band 7–8 — وليست كلمات نادرة للتباهي. بجانب كل كلمة معناها بالعربية وجملة واحدة.
Cooking should be part of the school curriculum.
Vocational training prepares students for real jobs.
Tuition fees have risen faster than family incomes.
Rote learning rarely produces critical thinkers.
Schools should teach critical thinking, not just facts.
The literacy rate has doubled in thirty years.
Education is compulsory until the age of sixteen.
Many rural students drop out of secondary school.
More women are enrolling in engineering courses.
Sport and music are part of a well-rounded education.
Peer pressure often drives teenage behaviour.
Lifelong learning is essential in a changing economy.
Job satisfaction matters more than salary to many people.
Remote work can improve work–life balance.
Companies offer competitive salaries to attract talent.
The unemployment rate among graduates is rising.
Women now make up half the workforce.
Thousands were made redundant when the factory closed.
Self-employed people have no guaranteed income.
The cost of living in Dhaka has risen sharply.
Families have less disposable income than a decade ago.
Garment workers are demanding a living wage.
Part-time work gives students some financial independence.
Advertising fuels consumerism among the young.
Children spend hours on digital devices every day.
AI is replacing routine office jobs.
Many teenagers are addicted to social media.
Apps collect data without respecting privacy.
Cybercrime costs banks billions every year.
The digital divide leaves rural students behind.
Our reliance on smartphones is growing.
Older workers struggle to keep up with new software.
Climate change threatens low-lying countries like Bangladesh.
Cars are a major source of carbon emissions.
We must reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
Solar power is the cheapest renewable energy.
The Sundarbans are rich in biodiversity.
Many countries have banned single-use plastic bags.
Households can conserve resources by recycling.
Extreme weather events are becoming more frequent.
A carbon tax would discourage polluting industries.
A balanced diet prevents many diseases.
الطعام المُصنَّع / الوجبات السريعة غير الصحية
Junk food is high in salt, sugar and fat.
Childhood obesity has tripled in twenty years.
Office work encourages a sedentary lifestyle.
Life expectancy has risen to over seventy.
A public health campaign cut smoking rates.

رادع (شيء يمنع الناس من فعل شيء)
Long sentences are not always an effective deterrent.

الخدمة المجتمعية (عقوبة بعمل غير مدفوع للمجتمع)

9. Media, culture and travel (الإعلام والثقافة والسفر)
The mass media shape public opinion.

10. Government and global issues (الحكومة والقضايا العالمية)
Government policy should favour public transport.
Higher taxation on sugar could reduce obesity.
Public spending on health has doubled.

هذه كلمات متقدمة، وخطر استخدامها بشكل خاطئ قليل — لذلك يمكن استخدامها في أي essay.
a great deal of, numerous, a considerable number of
it is widely believed, many argue, some maintain
employ, utilise, make use of, rely on
in recent years, today, at present (كلمة nowadays ليست خطأ، لكن الجميع يبدأ بها)
the elderly, older people, senior citizens
In my view, I believe, I would argue that
as a result, consequently, for this reason

⚠️ استخدم الـ upgrade فقط عندما تكون قد رأيت الكلمة مستخدمة في جملة. كلمة "utilise" صحيحة، لكن ليس "utilise the opportunity" ("seize / take the opportunity"). إذا كنت مترددًا، فاكتب الكلمة الشائعة — فهي ليست خطأ.

title: Exercises (مع الإجابات) وخطة التدريب الأسبوعية
blocks: Exercise 1 · حدّد النوع — A (argumentative)، N (narrative)، C (combination)
1. Many people believe zoos should be closed. To what extent do you agree?
2. What are the causes of childhood obesity, and what can be done to reduce it?
3. Some think university should be free; others think students should pay. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
4. More people are working from home. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative development?
5. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of international tourism.
6. Advertising aimed at children is harmful.
7. Should governments spend money on space exploration?
8. What problems does traffic congestion cause in big cities?
**الإجابة:** 1 A · 2 N · 3 A · 4 C · 5 N · 6 A (statement فقط) · 7 A (yes/no) · 8 N (problems فقط)
Exercise 2 · صحّح الـ double connector (أداة الربط المكرّرة)
1. Although the metro is cheap, but many people prefer taxis.
2. Because the exam was hard, so most students failed.
3. Despite of the rain, the match continued.
4. Even though he studied a lot, however he did not pass.

**الإجابة:** 1 Although the metro is cheap, many people prefer taxis. / The metro is cheap, but … · 2 Because the exam was hard, most students failed. / The exam was hard, so … · 3 Despite the rain, … (لا "of" بعد despite) · 4 Even though he studied a lot, he did not pass. / He studied a lot; however, he did not pass.
الكلمات: however · for instance · as a result · moreover · in conclusion

Online shopping has grown rapidly. ___(1), it is convenient and often cheaper. ___(2), consumers can compare prices on several sites in minutes. ___(3), it has drawbacks: returns are slow and local shops lose customers. ___(4), many high streets have empty units. ___(5), online shopping is useful but has costs for communities.
**الإجابة:** 1 Moreover (أو To begin with) · 2 For instance · 3 However · 4 As a result · 5 In conclusion
4. Prices increased ___ $500, reaching their highest level.
**الإجابة:** 1 by … between · 2 from … to · 3 at · 4 to
Students today face many pressures. Students must pass exams, students must find part-time work, and students also have to manage social media.
**إجابة نموذجية:** Students today face many pressures. They must pass exams and find part-time work, and young people also have to manage social media.
Exercise 6 · اكتشف الـ drift (الخروج عن الموضوع) — أي جملة لا يجب أن تكون في الـ paragraph؟

(1) Public transport should be free in large cities. (2) Free buses would reduce the number of cars and therefore cut pollution. (3) They would also help poorer residents reach jobs across the city. (4) My uncle drives a bus and says the traffic gets worse every year. (5) Several European cities that have tried free transport report cleaner air and busier city centres.
**الإجابة:** الجملة 4 — مع أنها عن الـ traffic، فهي لا تدعم الفكرة "transport should be free"، وهي قصة شخصية بدلًا من حجة.
Exercise 7 · Emphasiser (E) (أداة تأكيد) أم softener (S) (أداة تخفيف)؟
1. This is undoubtedly the main cause.
3. It is beyond doubt that exercise improves health.
4. Perhaps some students would prefer online classes.
5. This is the least the government can do.
**الإجابة:** 1 E · 2 S · 3 E · 4 S · 5 E (كلمة "least" تضيف تأكيدًا هنا)
Exercise 8 · اكتب overview (بدون أرقام، في جملة واحدة)
البيانات: الـ unemployment في Country X — 2010: 12% · 2014: 9% · 2018: 6% · 2022: 7%.
**إجابة نموذجية:** Overall, unemployment fell steadily for most of the period before rising slightly in the final years, finishing well below its starting level.
Some people think children should be taught to compete; others think they should be taught to cooperate. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
**إجابة نموذجية:** While competition can motivate a few high achievers, I believe that teaching children to cooperate produces more capable and happier adults.

Nowadays, many childrens are spending too much time on the phone. This is effect their study and their health. Parents should to limit the screen time, because it is very important for the future of the children, and also they can play outside more, and so it will be better.

**الإجابة:** childrens → children · This is effect → This is affecting (verb، continuous) · should to limit → should limit · the screen time → screen time · الجملة الأخيرة run-on ("and… and… so") — قسّمها: …for their future. They would also play outside more, which would be better for their health. (وأيضًا "on the phone" → "on their phones")
Governments should ban all advertising aimed at children. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
المطلوب: ضع خطًا تحت الموضوع (subject matter) → عمودان، for/against → رتّب الأفكار → اختر موقفك → اكتب الـ introduction (general + thesis). ثم قارن مع الخطة أدناه.

**خطة نموذجية:** For: children cannot judge advertising; junk-food ads drive obesity; pester power strains families. Against: ads fund children's TV; parents, not the state, should decide; a ban is hard to enforce online. الموقف: agree (حجج الـ for قوية، وحجج الـ against يمكن الرد عليها). Thesis: Although a ban may be difficult to enforce online, I firmly believe that children need this protection because they cannot recognise persuasion for what it is.
Exercise 12 · Task 1 — اكتب introduction + overview لهذا الـ table

**إجابة نموذجية:** The table compares the percentage of commuters using five forms of transport in one city in 2000 and 2020. Overall, the car remained the most common choice in both years but lost a substantial share, while rail and cycling grew markedly and walking was unchanged.

أعد كتابة essay يوم الثلاثاء بعد قراءة ملاحظات الـ AI؛ قارنها بإجابة نموذجية Band 7
راجع سجل أخطائك (error log)؛ 10 كلمات من الـ topics؛ راحة

**كيف تحتفظ بـ error log:** ثلاثة أعمدة في صفحة واحدة — الخطأ · التصحيح · كم مرة. بعد كل كتابة، أضف الأخطاء الجديدة. في آخر 5 دقائق من الامتحان، ابحث فقط عن الأخطاء الثلاثة الأكثر تكرارًا. خلال شهر، تتغيّر أكثر 3 أخطاء عند معظم الطلاب — أي أن الأخطاء السابقة قد عولجت.
هنا ينتهي الكتاب. اطبع قوائم المراجعة من كل الفصول معًا واجعلها أمامك؛ وبعد كل تدريب، قيّم نفسك بها. في الـ Writing، يرتفع الـ band بالعادة، لا بالسحر.
